definition: The Information Retrieval Facility (IRF), founded 2006 and located in Vienna, Austria, was a research platform for networking and collaboration for professionals in the field of information retrieval.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. That shared ruler is Information Retrieval Facility.
